## Helping RKR understand its audience

My part of the CEP focuses on Instagram content and engagement. I want to understand which content types and messages attract stronger responses and may support reservation intent. This dashboard is a prototype of how I could share those results with the client.

[Open the Quarto dashboard](dashboard.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## What the dashboard measures

| Measure | Calculation | How the client could use it |
|---|---|---|
| Engagement rate by reach | Engagements ÷ reach × 100 | Compare responses relative to exposure |
| Engagements | Likes + comments + saves + shares | Understand interaction volume |
| Profile actions | Total actions reported for the included posts | Explore interest beyond the post |

The sample CSV treats reach as the sum of post reach. A person may appear in the reach of more than one post, so this is **not unique campaign reach**. Profile actions are a total action count, not a count of unique people or reservations.

## From a prototype to client reporting

I would replace the [sample CSV](data/instagram-demo.csv) with an approved Instagram Insights export, use the same reporting period for each comparison, and document how each metric is defined. I would also code message styles and compare similar posting conditions. If tagged link data becomes available, I could examine Instagram referral activity separately.

For the pilot, I would compare a baseline period with a planned content test. Higher engagement alone would not establish that Instagram increased reservations. A small sample, repeat exposure, different posting times, and other marketing activity could affect the results.

## How this was built

The dashboard uses Quarto’s `format: dashboard`, cards, a chart, and a table. Its values were calculated from the included CSV during project preparation. The chart and table are static; after replacing the data, their summaries must be recalculated and the site rendered again. This version does not connect to Instagram or update automatically.

[Dashboard documentation](https://quarto.org/docs/dashboards/)
